(26 goals) |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches=264 |total goals=693 |prevseason=[[2015 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2015]] |nextseason=[[2017 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2017]] }} The '''2016 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A''' (officially known as the '''Copa Banco del Pacífico Serie A''' for sponsorship reasons) is the 58th season of the [[Ecuadorian Serie A|Serie A]]. ==Teams== Twelve teams are competing in the 2016 Serie A season, ten of whom remain from the previous season. [[LDU Loja]] and [[Deportivo Quito]] were relegated from the Serie A after accumulating the fewest points during the [[2015 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2015 season]]. They were replaced by [[Delfín Sporting Club|Delfín]] and [[Fuerza Amarilla Sporting Club|Fuerza Amarilla]], the 2015 Serie B winner and runner-up, respectively. Delfín is making their 11th top-flight appearance and their first return to the Serie A since 2001, while Fuerza Amarilla is participating in their first top-flight appearance. === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Ecuador |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2016 Serie A teams. |places= {{location map~ |Ecuador |lat=-0.278859 |long=-78.546202 |label=
